title: WPA Institute Index Methodology Candidate
subtitle: 20-Indicator Computational Specification
principle: Measure documented institutional capacity and transparency through public evidence; do not imply accreditation, official recognition, legal judgment or paid ranking.

doctrine.public_formula: We do not rank. We measure.
doctrine.missing_evidence_rule: Not evidenced is not zero and is not estimated.
doctrine.human_gate: Consequential public scoring, corrections and methodology changes require authorised human review.

indicators.name: Verified research output
indicators.definition: Verified books, scholarly articles, working papers, policy papers, manuals, studies or comparable research outputs relevant to the institution's mission.

indicators.name: Research traceability
indicators.definition: Persistent and verifiable research identifiers and metadata such as DOI, ISBN, ISSN, repository records, ORCID or comparable authoritative records where applicable.

indicators.name: Citation and reference visibility
indicators.definition: Verifiable citation, reference, discovery or scholarly visibility evidence; popularity metrics alone do not qualify.

indicators.name: Protocol and diplomacy knowledge contribution
indicators.definition: Documented original contribution to protocol, diplomacy, foreign-service education, ceremonial practice or closely related institutional knowledge.

indicators.name: International research collaboration
indicators.definition: Verified cross-institutional or international research collaboration, co-authorship or research participation supported by public evidence.

indicators.name: Programme architecture
indicators.definition: Publicly understandable programme structure, levels, modules, duration or equivalent learning pathway.

indicators.name: Learning outcomes
indicators.definition: Explicit, mission-relevant learning outcomes or competence statements.

indicators.name: Assessment discipline
indicators.definition: Documented assessment, examination, simulation, practical evaluation or comparable learning-assurance rules.

indicators.name: Faculty and practitioner transparency
indicators.definition: Publicly verifiable information on instructors, faculty, trainers or practitioners and the expertise relevant to their teaching role.

indicators.name: Credential and completion integrity
indicators.definition: Transparent status, verification and issuance rules for certificates, diplomas, completion records or equivalent credentials, including clear non-degree or accreditation boundaries where applicable.

indicators.name: Documented institutional practice
indicators.definition: Public evidence of real institutional, diplomatic, protocol, ceremonial or related professional practice.

indicators.name: Applied protocol and diplomacy cases
indicators.definition: Documented applied cases, case studies, field exercises or institutional applications relevant to protocol and diplomacy.

indicators.name: Simulations and practice-based training
indicators.definition: Structured simulations, exercises, scenario work, practical workshops or comparable experiential learning.

indicators.name: Practitioner integration
indicators.definition: Documented integration of diplomats, protocol officers, ceremonial professionals, public officials or other relevant practitioners into learning or research.

indicators.name: Knowledge transfer and documented impact
indicators.definition: Verifiable transfer of expertise into institutions, professional communities, public guidance, training outcomes or other documented mission-relevant impact.

indicators.name: Institutional identity and governance clarity
indicators.definition: Clear public identity, legal or organisational status where applicable, governance structure, responsible contacts and non-misleading institutional representation.

indicators.name: Evidence, provenance and correction mechanism
indicators.definition: Public-source discipline, source traceability, correction or review route and visible handling of uncertainty or disputed information.

indicators.name: Verified international cooperation
indicators.definition: International cooperation supported by documentary or authoritative public evidence; unverified partnership language does not qualify.

indicators.name: Digital and multilingual public transparency
indicators.definition: Accessible institutional information, programme and research discoverability, multilingual clarity where relevant and usable public contact routes; follower counts are not treated as quality.

indicators.name: Ethics, COI, data and credential governance
indicators.definition: Public evidence of ethics, conflict-of-interest, data/privacy, academic-integrity and credential-governance safeguards appropriate to the institution's activities.

scale.label: Verified non-conformance
scale.anchor: Sufficient evidence shows that the criterion is absent, contradicted or materially fails the published standard.

scale.label: Minimal
scale.anchor: A limited or ad hoc element exists, with weak structure or verification.

scale.label: Basic
scale.anchor: A recognisable practice exists but remains incomplete, inconsistent or weakly evidenced.

scale.label: Established
scale.anchor: The criterion is clearly implemented and supported by adequate evidence.

scale.label: Strong
scale.anchor: The criterion is mature, consistently implemented and supported by strong primary or authoritative evidence.

scale.label: Exemplary
scale.anchor: The criterion demonstrates unusually strong, reproducible and well-governed practice supported by high-quality evidence.

scale.label: Not evidenced
scale.anchor: Public evidence is insufficient to assign a score. NE is neither zero nor an estimated value.

scoring.evidence_coverage_formula: evidenced_weight_percent = sum(indicator_weight_percent for all non-NE indicators)
scoring.candidate_composite_formula: candidate_composite = 100 * sum(contribution for non-NE indicators) / evidenced_weight_percent

source_tiers.name: Authoritative external
examples: independent registry or established academic database

rules: Official or authoritative evidence is preferred wherever reasonably available.
A score of 4 or 5 should normally include at least one Tier A or Tier B source directly supporting the criterion.
Tier D evidence cannot by itself support a score above 2.
URL presence alone does not equal verification.
Follower counts, likes and general popularity are not academic or professional quality indicators.
Each scored claim should retain source URL or identifier, retrieval date and assessor note.
evidence_model.temporal_note: A five-year window may be used for time-bounded activity metrics. Foundational monographs, enduring standards and historical institutional evidence may remain relevant for traceability but should not be double-counted as current activity.

peer_comparison.principle: Absolute criterion score first; peer comparison second.

validation_plan.pilot: Pilot 20 dry run before any public real-institution scoring.
validation_plan.double_scoring: At least two independent scoring passes for the pilot, with disagreements logged and reconciled through human review.
validation_plan.indicator_correlation: Check whether indicators are duplicating the same signal. High correlation is a review trigger, not an automatic deletion rule.
validation_plan.edge_case_testing: Test small specialist academies, state diplomatic academies, university-linked schools and international training bodies separately.
validation_plan.correction_window: Real-institution pilot findings must allow a documented factual correction and evidence-submission window before any consequential publication.
validation_plan.aab_gate: AAB methodological review activates only after the AAB is formally constituted and conflicts of interest are documented.
validation_plan.v1_freeze_gate: Before v1.0, freeze the exact indicator definitions, weights, formulas, source rules, dataset snapshot date, changelog and correction procedure.

required_outputs: candidate composite when evidence thresholds are satisfied
secondary peer percentile only when sample-size rules are satisfied
methodology version and dataset snapshot date
finalisation_gates: Record-level evidence and source-verification procedure documented.
Twenty indicator definitions and 0-5/NE scoring anchors tested for consistency.
Pilot 20 dry run completed without public ordinal ranking.
Independent double-scoring completed and material disagreements logged.
Evidence-coverage thresholds tested against edge cases.
Conflict-of-interest and correction procedure published and tested.
AAB or equivalent independent methodological review completed and logged after formal constitution.
Public wording distinguishes measurement from accreditation, legal recognition and official ranking.
Exact v1.0 methodology, dataset snapshot, formulas and changelog frozen before any public ordinal ranking decision.
publication_rule: This candidate may be publicly inspected and used for synthetic or controlled pilot testing. It must not be represented as Institute Index v1.0, accreditation, official recognition or a final global ranking. Real-institution ordinal ranking remains disabled until the finalisation gates and a separate governance decision are satisfied.
